Entry Poor Fellows The Assembly of the Poor was composed of non-aristocratic armed monks and derived its power from the fervor of faith and the anger of the neglected. Knights may despise their lack of etiquette, but villagers will be moved by their commitment to justice; when religion takes up arms, order and fanaticism are often separated. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.
